name: yf_balance_sheet
description:
Balance sheets (total assets, liabilities, equity, cash, debt and more) for one company from Yahoo Finance (yfinance balance_sheet).
Returns: {symbol, statements: [one row per reporting period, newest first, with "index" = period end date and one key per line item]}; Yahoo usually has about 4 annual or 4-5 quarterly periods.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; quarterly (boolean; default false = annual).
Related: yf_income_statement, yf_cash_flow; other sources: av_balance_sheet, openbb_balance_sheet.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "quarterly": true}

quarterly.description: true for quarterly statements, false for annual
